0022600100.text: The New Orleans Pelicans visit the Utah Jazz in a game that marks the Pelicans' second of the 2026-27 season, and neither team has played a 2026-27 game yet. Utah is missing Jusuf Nurkic (foot), Tony Bradley (quadriceps), and Trey Alexander (knee), all listed as out. The Pelicans won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 156-137 win in New Orleans on April 7, 2026.
